sections.title: CORSI/JI-2303/JI-PLT_2303_Receipt_WF_ADDITIONS
paragraphs: ADD THE FOLLOWING STEP BETWEEN "Cost Check" and "Create Inventory Receipts" STEP:
ADD THIS ACTIVITY BETWEEN "Cost Check" ACTIVITY and "Create Inventory" ACTIVITY:

<Activity name="SpecialItems"> <ActivityType>manual</ActivityType> <StepRef name="Special Items" /> <Rule><![CDATA[Document.RequiresRuleGroupEvaluation("Special Item Approvals") == true]]></Rule> <FolderSelectionRule>MultiElementDynamic</FolderSelectionRule> <Attribute name="RuleGroupInternalName"> <AttrValue lang="default">Special Item Approvals</AttrValue> </Attribute> <Attribute name="wfActivitySupportNote"> <AttrValue lang="default">This is an ADW activity that checks a Rule Group called Special Item Approvals to see whether a Receipt requires approval, and by whom. Rules here should be based at least partly on what items were purchased, for example Capital Expenses or IT or chemicals and reagents. The client can create or manage rules and approvers for that Rule Group at any time, from the ADW tab.</AttrValue> </Attribute> <Attribute name="wfActivityHelp"> <AttrValue lang="default">This ADW activity checks the Rule Group called Special Item Approvals to see whether a Receipt requires approval because of what was purchased, and by whom. </AttrValue> </Attribute> </Activity>

sections.title: REPLACE ACTIVITY RELATIONSHIPS LINES WITH THESE:
paragraphs: <ActivityRelationship previous="START" next="CostCheck" /> <ActivityRelationship previous="CostCheck" next="SpecialItems" /> <ActivityRelationship previous="SpecialItems" next="Create Inventory" /> <ActivityRelationship previous="Create Inventory" next="END" />
CREATE A RULE GROUP CALLED "Special Item Approvals" IN YOUR SITE, THEN IMPORT YOUR EDITED DEFINITIONS FILE AND MAKE THAT VERSION ACTIVE!
